description: Route-1 care price 300->200: care-price elasticity now resists, so the ceiling is no longer optimal; expect the interior optimum ~EUR200/mo

Capacity 15->32 h/wk: subcontracting makes added hours productive (more served clients) and freed-hour reinvestment makes idle capacity neutral, so the v1 low-capacity artifact should lift toward the market-saturating knee

Route allocation 0.5/0.5 -> 0.24 local / 0.76 b2b: subcontracted B2B scales far past v1's solo-service cap, so tilt hours to B2B while keeping enough local to saturate its care-annuity pool (expect a mixed optimum, not a corner)

Route-2 retainer 2400->2500: retainer elasticity is mild, so pricing at the top of what service capacity can hold still nets more (confirms the v1 'price at service capacity' finding under the v2 model)

PROBE capacity 32->40: at cap 32 both channels already saturate (Route-2 at market cap, Route-1 at pool), so extra hours reinvest neutrally; expect DISCARD, confirming 32 is the interior knee not a peg-to-max
